response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software developer with a strong track record across many languages and frameworks, but his background shows no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or deep-learning workload performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. His experience is almost entirely in web/backend/product engineering, not hardware-software co-design or system architecture for AI chips, making him a poor fit despite meeting general seniority and education requirements.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Strong open-source contributions and public speaking/teaching track record
Meets baseline education and years-of-experience requirements
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture
No evidence of GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator-specific work
No background in deep learning workload performance/power optimization

key_factors.factor: Lack of SoC/IP and hardware architecture experience
